about: Plug-on confirm launch (coordinator, Nov 17 morning order (i)): after the monitors-off launch 20261117-002048 read DIFFER, the same con_custodial launch with Corey's monitors switched back on must show the plug-on state (and its frame time) is back, before any frame-time comparison resumes.
